result.topic_en: Calculations on log Γ (log Π) of complex argument (1/4 + ti/2), i.e. the argument of Gamma relevant to the Riemann–Siegel theta function, via integral representations and asymptotic series, followed by a Beta-integral saddle-point attempt and a recursive table of coefficients for an asymptotic expansion.

methods.what: Integral representation of the digamma function
Binet's formula for log Gamma (Stirling with integral remainder)
Shifted Binet/Stirling formula for log Γ(λ+1/4)
Real and imaginary parts of log Γ(1/4+it/2) − (it/2)log π (theta function), with asymptotic series involving Euler numbers 1, 61, 1385
Asymptotic series for τ with Euler numbers
Beta integral for product of Gamma values, with saddle point determination
Series ansatz for solving an ODE and recursion for the double-indexed coefficients b_m^n, tabulated
Expansion of (1−e^{−2τ})/2 in powers of 1/x with x^4=32t^2
